scope: A first-class rifle-ammunition Army needs view connecting real reported need, production, separate physical shipment stages and observation. Other military resources remain wider work; do not claim a general demand planner.

owners.query: game/logistics/army_supply_view.gd: pure view(session) reads authoritative current facts without advancing time, creating demand or moving goods.
owners.intent: Existing RearLogistics owns player cancellation holds and a new explicit idempotent resume_automatic_supply(type) command; a detached supply_intent(type) query exposes intent without leaking mutable private dictionaries.
owners.presentation: UI/UX owns only game/logistics/army_supply_panel.gd in an isolated branch; lead owns the real reader, commands, navigation and final integration.
owners.physical: Existing military, rear/forward transport, issue and ledger services remain authoritative. A narrow ledger available-stock batch reads all relevant stores in one pass; the resupply owner batches personal rounds and courier commitments once for its reported rifle recipients.

panel_contract.bind: bind(session: Node, reader: Callable); reader.call(session) returns a detached current view. Never install fake simulation data or directly call logistics commands.
panel_contract.state: Public view Dictionary for current presentation; retain selected recipient by stable id across updates.
panel_contract.signal: action_requested(action: Dictionary) delegates to the lead-owned rear controller.

view.title: Human-readable supply title
view.summary: Human-readable current real need and supply context
view.recipients: Array of {id,label,needed,carried,committed,remaining,reported,issued,detail}: current reported needs plus actual personal receipts indexed by the latest named refill. Current possession, reported deficit and past issued quantity are separate.
view.stages: Array of {label,quantity_text,detail}; rear stock, HQ receipt, forward freight and actual issue are separate facts, never a fabricated one-to-one shipment trace.
view.requests: Array of {id,label,state,requested,delivered,blocker,cancelled}; quantities describe actual rear requests/HQ receipt.
view.blockers: Array of readable causes; avoid technical codes in primary text.
view.held: Boolean owner-provided automatic resupply cancellation intent.
view.actions: Array of {id,label,enabled,panel,facility_id,building_kind,request_id}; semantic ids produce/build, workers, rear_requests, observe, resume_automatic. Observe adds current selected entity_id when available. Disabled/absent actions do not execute.
view.rear_shortage: Current military supply shortfall after local/forward commitments/HQ coverage; not by itself an instruction to manufacture this amount because rear stock and rear deliveries may already cover it.

lifecycle: Coalesce finite signal bursts into one deferred visible read. Hidden panels retain dirty state without reading. Rebinding/exit disconnect all old subscribers and discard old selections/actions. Deferred work resolves the current session; replacement disables old actions immediately. Latest named-cycle personal receipts remain followable after request removal; later cycles replace prior receipt context. See refill_continuity.json.
no_polling: No new process/physics callback, timer or time_advanced subscription. Use current owner indexes/batched rounds once per actual visible update; no world snapshot or per-member whole-ledger export.
resume_semantics: Only explicit player action clears a type's automatic hold. Repeated resume is harmless. It does not uncancel an old request, credit cargo, create a manual amount, rewind departure or bypass Pause. The next existing owned resupply event publishes freshly computed need.
navigation: Add an ordinary Army needs rear tab/navigation entry. Existing expert forward controls remain available and distinct. Production links resolve the real selected munitions facility; observation never creates an order or guarantees battle success.
unchanged: Starting6000 HQ rifle rounds, prices, recipes, physical rates, military decisions and all other supply quantities stay unchanged. A lack of a genuine shortage is shown truthfully rather than manufactured.
principles: Observer pattern and bounded visible presentation
direct_check_scope: Briefly demonstrate new query purity, hold/resume semantics, signal-driven lifecycle and ordinary navigation. No broad suite, forced shortage, benchmark or complete ordinary resupply-cycle claim.
